description: This file defines the I18nController class that implements ReactiveController interface for managing internationalization subscriptions within a lit-based web component. It sets up and tears down subscription callbacks to update the host component when language or translation data changes.

classes.name: I18nController
classes.description: A reactive controller that subscribes to an internationalization service and updates its host component when locale or translation data changes.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the controller and registers it with the host component.

methods.name: hostConnected
methods.description: Sets up subscription to internationalization updates and triggers component update on change.

methods.name: hostDisconnected
methods.description: Cleans up the subscription when the host component disconnects.
